# dsh-claude-code-theme **Claude Desktop's visual language for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.** Warm paper neutrals, terracotta accent, readable prose, quiet layered surfaces and a continuous composer — applied through DSH's own theme extension point, not by patching its stylesheets. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-code-theme) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](./LICENSE)
## Before and after Stock DSH — right-aligned bubble on a blue-tinted canvas, soft 12–28px corners, a floating composer with a circular send button: With the theme — a deeper sidebar, a raised right-hand panel, prose set for reading, compact tool summaries, and a continuous composer: Light mode, on Claude's cream canvas with white raised sheets: --- ## Install ```sh dsh plugin install dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Or add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and its package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`: ```yaml - insert: - id: claude-code-theme name: dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Reload the Web GUI. There is nothing to switch on: the theme composes over whichever palette you already use, so `light`, `dark` and `system` all keep working. ## What changes **Colour.** DSH's design system has three token tiers, and the theme works on all three: | Tier | What it is | What the theme does | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-static-*` | The raw colour ramps | Retints DSH's blue-tinted greys to Claude's warm paper greys, and DeepSeek blue to terracotta. The alias tier resolves through these, so this alone recolours most of the application. | | `--dsw-alias-*` | The semantic roles components consume | Pins the roles Claude treats differently: a cream canvas under raised sheets, a terracotta primary button and focus ring, warm hairlines, and text that stops short of pure white on dark. | | `--dsw-specific-*` | Named surfaces | Retunes the sidebar, composer, bubbles, menus and code surfaces. | **Surface hierarchy.** Claude Desktop stacks depth rather than flattening it, so the theme gives each column its own level instead of one shared grey: | Region | Dark | Light | | --- | --- | --- | | Sidebar | `#111110` (deepest) | `#f5f3ec` | | Canvas | `#171716` | `#faf9f5` | | Raised sheets — cards, composer, right panel | `#1d1d1b` | `#ffffff` | The right panel becomes a raised sheet separated by a hairline instead of floating as a detached card. **Geometry.** DSH routes **280 `border-radius` declarations through six `--dsw-radius-*` tokens** (measured across all 179 shipped UI bundles), so the theme re-points the scale itself: | Token | DSH | Theme | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-radius-xs` | 4px | 4px | | `--dsw-radius-sm` | 8px | 6px | | `--dsw-radius-md` | 12px | 8px | | `--dsw-radius-lg` | 16px | 12px | | `--dsw-radius-xl` | 20px | 16px | | `--dsw-radius-panel` | 28px | 20px | The corners that bypass the scale are reached through the stable `data-slot` and `data-*` hooks rather than a build hash. **Typography.** This is the part that most decides whether the result reads as a product or as a costume. Claude Desktop is a reading surface, so the transcript is set in the UI sans at a comfortable line height, and monospace is kept for the things that are actually code: | | Treatment | | --- | --- | | Assistant prose | UI sans, 1.65 line height, normal heading letter-spacing | | Inline code, code blocks, tool output | Monospace | | Sidebar, header, composer | UI sans | | Code-block banner | Sentence case, not shouted uppercase | **Transcript.** Your turn is a right-aligned bubble on a quiet surface; the assistant's is prose on the canvas; tool calls collapse into single-line summaries (`Ran 2 commands ›`) that expand in place, which is how Claude Desktop keeps a long working session scannable. **Composer.** One continuous rounded surface: the editor and the controls share a single card with no divider between them, the submit control is a circle, and focus draws a soft terracotta ring rather than a hard outline. **Chrome.** Quiet navigation rows instead of an elevated primary button, hover states limited to enabled controls, `focus-visible` rings for keyboard use, and thin warm scrollbars. ## Customisation Everything the component layer decides reads a `--cct-*` property declared once on `body`, so you can retune it from your own CSS without patching the package: ```css body { /* A serif reading face, the way long-form prose is often set. */ --cct-prose: Georgia, "Songti SC", serif; /* Roomier or tighter surfaces. */ --cct-composer-radius: 24px; --cct-control-radius: 6px; --cct-editor-inset: 20px; } ``` | Knob | Default | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `--cct-sans` | system UI stack | UI face, including the sidebar and composer | | `--cct-prose` | `var(--cct-sans)` | Face used for assistant prose only | | `--cct-mono` | DSH's code stack | Code, tool output and paths | | `--cct-control-radius` | `8px` | Buttons, rows, chips, code blocks | | `--cct-composer-radius` | `18px` | The composer surface | | `--cct-editor-inset` | `16px` | Composer text inset from its edge | | `--cct-focus` | brand primary | Focus ring colour | To retune colours instead, stack your own layer on top — later layers win per token: ```js ctx.theme.overrideTokens('my-tweaks', { '--dsw-alias-brand-primary': { light: '#c96442', dark: '#d97757' }, }) ``` ## How it works The plugin is a browser half plus an inert host row. The browser half (`lib/client.js`) does exactly two things, both inside one Cordis effect, so unloading or HMR removes the theme completely: 1. Calls `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-claude-code-theme', …)` with 174 tokens as `{ light, dark }` pairs. This is DSH's documented third-party theme extension point. The service stacks the layer over the active palette and `ui-layout` writes it as inline custom properties on `` — which is why the theme outranks the base palette sheets without `!important`, and why overriding the `--dsw-static-*` ramps propagates to every alias that resolves through them. 2. plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: Unified rail for the DSH sidebar: sort the top panels and the bottom actions as one list. / DSH 左侧栏统一排序插件：顶部面板与底部动作混排成同一条序列。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-railist

**English** | [中文](#中文)

---

## English

Manage the whole DSH left column as one list: reorder rows across the panel list and the footer action row, rename them, change their icons, hide them, and fold them into Groups. Everything is configured in a new Settings tab and applies immediately.

> A fork of [dsh-panellist](https://github.com/qwq1999/dsh-panellist). Upstream manages the panel list alone; this fork extends it to a single sequence spanning two seats.

---

## Features

- **One sequence across seats** — the panel list and the footer action row are sorted as a single list, so a row can be dragged from one into the other.
- **Reorder by drag** — drag any row to a new position; the rail follows the list live.
- **Rename and re-icon** — give any row your own label and pick its icon from a built-in set.
- **Show / hide** — take a row off the rail without uninstalling its plugin.
- **Groups** — fold several rows into one Group row with a flyout menu; ungroup at any time.
- **Appearance override** — adjust the rail's own look from the Settings tab.
- **Config file's full path** — shown in Settings so you can back it up or edit it.

The Settings row itself always stays last and cannot be dragged, and every change is written to disk only when you press Save.

## Screenshots

| Settings → Panel list | Appearance override | A Group menu on the rail |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| ![Settings → Panel list](docs/images/settings-panel-list.png) | ![Appearance override](docs/images/settings-appearance.png) | ![A Group menu on the rail](docs/images/rail-group-menu.png) |

## Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-railist
```

Then restart DSH. To remove it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-railist
```

## Compatibility

| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Profile | `web` |
| Platform | Windows / macOS / Linux desktop |

## Configuration

Your settings live in `~/.dsh/railist.json`. The full path is also shown in the Settings tab. If a row's plugin is missing or disabled, the row is kept in the file and marked as missing rather than being deleted.

## License

MIT

---

## 中文

把 DSH 左侧栏当成一整条列表来管理：跨「面板区」与「底部动作区」调整顺序、重命名、换图标、隐藏，以及把若干行折叠成分组。全部在设置页完成，改完立即生效。

> 本项目 fork 自 [dsh-panellist](https://github.com/qwq1999/dsh-panellist)。上游只管理面板区；本 fork 把它扩展成跨越两个区域的同一条序列。

---

## 功能

- **跨区域同一条序列** —— 面板区与底部动作区当成一条列表排序，所以一个行可以从一个区域拖进另一个区域。
- **拖动排序** —— 把任意行拖到新位置，左侧栏实时跟随。
- **重命名与换图标** —— 给任意行起自己的名字，并从内置图标集里挑图标。
- **显示 / 隐藏** —— 把某一行从左侧栏隐藏，而不必卸载它的插件。
- **分组** —— 把若干行折叠成一个分组行（带展开菜单），随时可以解组。
- **外观覆盖** —— 在设置页调整左侧栏自身的外观。
- **配置文件全路径** —— 设置页直接显示，方便你备份或手动编辑。

「设置」那一行固定在最下方、不可拖动；所有改动都要点保存才会写进磁盘。

## 效果图

| 设置 → 面板列表 | 外观覆盖 | 左侧栏上的分组菜单 |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| ![设置 → 面板列表](docs/images/settings-panel-list.png) | ![外观覆盖](docs/images/settings-appearance.png) | ![左侧栏上的分组菜单](docs/images/rail-group-menu.png) |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-railist
```

装完重启 DSH。卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-railist
```

## 兼容版本

| 要求 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Profile | `web` |
| 平台 | Windows / macOS / Linux 桌面端 |

## 配置

配置存在 `~/.dsh/railist.json`，设置页里也会显示完整路径。如果某一行的插件被卸载或停用，这一行会保留在配置里并标记为「已缺失」，不会被自动删掉。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-control

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Every machine already runs dsh. Make this one window the front end for all of them.**

Chat with the dsh instances on your other machines, natively from your local sidebar.
Remote sessions stream back token by token; the remote uses its own model credentials,
tools and sandbox. Zero changes on the remote. Zero dependencies. One-line install.

![dsh-control in action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/hero.png)

*Two dsh windows answering the same question. The left window shows a session auto-named
`控制端·<local title>` (①) — that naming only happens on the machine the plugin drives. The right
window shows the workspace `cn-dsh2` the plugin created (②) and the model route set to the
environment name (③).*

> 🎬 A 15-second capture (one-click connect → streaming reply) is being recorded.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add github:6mt/dsh-control
```

Use the profile you already run (usually `web` or `desktop`). No build step, no native
modules, no dependencies — the plugin is plain JavaScript and installs as-is.

<details>
<summary>GitHub slow or blocked? Install from the release tarball instead</summary>

Download [dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz](https://github.com/6mt/dsh-control/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz)
and run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add ./dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz
```
</details>

After installing, **fully quit and reopen dsh** (⌘Q). A「远程 dsh 环境」panel appears
in the right sidebar.

> An npm package (`dsh-control`) is prepared and can be published later; the GitHub
> command above is the current install path.

## Versions & updating

- **What you get**: `github:6mt/dsh-control` installs the newest commit of `main` and
  **pins it in your profile's lockfile** — it does not silently follow later commits.
- **Update**: `dsh plugin --profile <your profile> update dsh-control`
  *(pnpm re-resolves the git ref and pulls the new code)*
- **Pin a version**: `github:6mt/dsh-control#v0.1.0` (tag) or `github:6mt/dsh-control#<commit>`
- Changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## How is this different from dsh-remote / dsh-remote-ssh?

![How the two approaches differ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/compare.svg)

| | Remote-workspace plugins (dsh-remote, …) | **dsh-control** |
|---|---|---|
| The remote machine is a | **file system** (SFTP tool set) | **dsh that is already running there** |
| Sessions live | local session + remote directory | **remote sessions, native in your sidebar** |
| Credentials & tools | configured locally, SSH config duplicated | the remote's own — nothing copied |
| Remote needs | only SSH | dsh installed (≥0.2.0-rc.2) with its web instance running |
| Changes on the remote | some deploy dsh for you | **zero** (read-only probing + the remote's own API) |

The two **coexist** (tested side by side): no dsh on the remote → use dsh-remote;
dsh already there → use dsh-control.

## What it does

![The remote dsh environments panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/panel.png)

*The「远程 dsh 环境」panel: type `user@host` and connect — the row then reports its state and
whether the environment already has its workspace.*

- **One-click connect** — type `user@host`; the plugin probes the remote dsh, fetches
  its access token and opens an encrypted channel (~5 s)
- **Automatic workspace** — each environment gets a same-named local workspace; any
  session created inside it automatically becomes a remote session
- **True streaming** — remote replies flow in token by token, not dumped at the end
- **Paired naming** — remote sessions are named `控制端·<local title>`, so both sides match
- **Visible & self-healing** — remote sessions are marked in the sidebar; disconnects
  are reported honestly and repaired by one click

## Security

**What it does on your machine**: one state file
(`$DSH_HOME/dsh-control/state.json`, mode 0600, holds the remote access tokens) and an
on-demand SSH tunnel process.
**What it never does**: no installs or writes on the remote, no lifecycle management of
the remote dsh, never reads your other local credentials, tokens never enter logs.
When passwordless SSH is not set up it shows the exact one-line fix — passwords are
never stored. Details in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Known limitations

- The remote must already run dsh with its web instance (otherwise use a
  remote-workspace plugin)
- Connects over SSH (passwordless or configured key; a direct no-SSH mode is on the roadmap)
- Sidebar markers and the streaming feel are verified by eye per release
- Cancelling a remote turn is implemented but marked experimental

## Development

```sh
node --check lib/*.js
for t in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$t"; done   # 52 checks: unit / contract / structural invariants
scripts/verify-boot-selfheal.sh                # boot self-heal (needs a local dsh runtime)
```

## License

MIT © 6mt

# dsh-general-agentics **General Agentics 發行套件（bundle）for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)。** 用戶先安裝 DSH，再安裝本套件，一次獲得： 1. **貼牌**：側邊欄 mark/wordmark、對話首頁 hero 文字 logo 與致敬行、品牌主色、分頁標題、favicon、輸入框下方的 START HERE 模塊（皆為執行期替換，不修改、不破壞已安裝的 DSH） 2. **自帶技能**：14 個（`ga-identity` ＋ 13 個方法論技能，見下） 3. **MCP 預配置**：`ga-status`（`ga_bundle_info` 身分回報 ＋ `ga_health_check` 安裝健康自檢） 4. **設定面板**：Settings → General Agentics（bundle 版本、每個精選插件的版本與更新狀態、隨附技能、一鍵／手動更新） 5. **13 個精選第三方插件**：隨套件安裝並啟用（見「精選插件」一節） Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed. ## 設計原則 - **只走官方縫隙**：品牌透過三個 generic brand slot 佔位（`priority: -1` 陰影覆蓋官方 occupants——slot 規則是「同 cell 最低 priority 者渲染」），不停用 `ui-brand-official`，不修改任何 DSH 檔案。 - **不破簽章、不怕升級**：本套件存在於 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles//node_modules`），DSH 升級不會覆蓋它；解除安裝即完全還原官方品牌。 - **手寫、零建置**：`lib/client.js` 採用 shell module loader 的 lazy-CJS 形狀（與 dsh-pomodoro 等第三方出貨格式一致），無需 repo 內未發佈的 build preset。 ## 覆蓋範圍（誠實清單） | 表面 | 本套件 | 備註 | |---|---|---| | 側邊欄 mark / wordmark | ✅ | slot 佔位；2026-10-13 瀏覽器實測（乾淨 profile）確認渲染 | | 對話首頁 hero mark | ✅ | slot 佔位；實測確認我們的 wordmark 渲染 | | 品牌主色 | ✅ | `theme.overrideTokens`（light/dark 成對，契約要求）。注意 token 寫在 `` 的 inline style 上，不是 `:root`；量測時別探 `document.documentElement` | | 分頁標題 | ✅ | 執行期改寫 + MutationObserver 抵抗 shell 重設；實測 `document.title === "General Agentics"` | | favicon | ✅ | 執行期替換 `link[rel=icon]`；實測兩個 link 皆為 data URI 且含品牌色 | | PWA 名稱 | ⚠️ 盡力 | manifest link 換 data URI，瀏覽器是否採納視實作 | | 首跑 Preview Notice 彈窗 | ❌ 未覆蓋 | client 樹內字串，一次點名 DeepSeek Harness 三次，是客戶第一眼看到的畫面。2026-10-13 瀏覽器實測發現；client.js 修得到（尚未修） | | Hero tagline「Into the Unknown」 | ❌ 未覆蓋 | 與我們的 hero wordmark 並排顯示；同為 client 樹內字串，尚未修 | | 桌面殼（Dock icon／選單／About） | ❌ | 在簽章保護的 app.asar 內，本套件不碰 | | host 端字串（system prompt、User-Agent） | ❌ | 硬編碼；以 `ga-identity` skill 於任務層補償 | ## 安裝 ```sh # 方式一：GUI（App 運行中）——側欄 Plugins → Add plugin → 貼包名或本機路徑 dsh-general-agentics # npm 包名（發佈後） /path/to/dsh-general-agentics # 本機 clone 的絕對路徑 # 方式二：模型側工具（App 運行中）——對話中請 agent 執行 # plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-general-agentics" } # 方式三：CLI（desktop profile 須先完全退出桌面 App） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-general-agentics ``` 安裝後： - **網頁重新整理一次**（Cmd+R）即可載入品牌 client half（側邊欄 mark/wordmark、hero 文字 logo 與致敬行、主色、分頁標題、favicon、輸入框下方的 START HERE 模塊） - **新建的 session** 會獲得 `ga-identity` 等 14 個技能與 `mcp__ga-status__ga_bundle_info` 工具（MCP 伺服器於組合套用時即由 host spawn） - 完全重啟 App 亦無妨 **解除安裝／停用**： ```sh # 停用（保留檔案）：GUI Plugins 頁關閉 bundle，或在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 寫： # - id: general-agentics # disabled: true # 解除安裝：GUI Plugins → Remove，或退出 App 後 CLI： dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-general-agentics ``` **開發迭代**：以 `link:` 指向本機 clone 安裝——改 `lib/client.js` 後重新整理頁面即生效； 改 `cordis.patch.yml` 或 `lib/index.js`（host 半）則套用新組合（HMR live）。 內容變更後重新以 `file:` 安裝時記得升版號——pnpm 對同版號的 `file:` 包可能不重新解包。 離線驗證組合用拋棄式 profile：見 `docs/ops-lessons.md` rule 13。 **發布前注意**： - LICENSE 已在 repo 根目錄（npm 自動收入 tarball） - MCP row 已是可攜形式（`process.execPath` + `baseUrl`，見 `cordis.patch.yml`；實測紀錄在 `docs/ops-lessons.md` rule 14） - 對外表述維持 "Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed" ## 套件結構 ``` dsh-general-agentics/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 宣告＋精選插件 dependencies ├── cordis.patch.yml # 本套件 Loader row＋MCP row＋精選插件 insert rows ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # host half：技能 provider（掃 skills/ 註冊） │ └── client.js # browser half：品牌 slot、主題、標題/favicon、START HERE ├── brand/ │ ├── mark.svg # 佔位 mark 設計檔（client.js 內有對應 inline 版本） │ └── wordmark.svg # 佔位 wordmark 設計檔 ├── skills/ │ ├── ga-identity/ # 自帶技能：General Agentics 身分與簽署 │ ├── (13 個方法論技能) # vendored from obra/superpowers @ bb92a77（MIT，逐字未改） │ ├── superpowers/ # 上游 LICENSE + UPSTREAM-SHA（無 SKILL.md，不註冊） │ └── THIRD-PARTY.md # 署名與更新指引 ├── mcp/ │ └── ga-status-server.mjs # ga_bundle_info 狀態回報（零依賴 stdio MCP server） └── test/ └── skill-provider.test.mjs # node --test，零依賴 ``` ## 換正式品牌素材 | 要換什麼 | 改哪裡 | |---|---| | 產品名稱 | `lib/client.js` 的 `PRODUCT_NAME` / `PRODUCT_SHORT_NAME` | | mark 圖形 | `lib/client.js` 的 `GAMark`（paths）＋ `brand/mark.svg` | | wordmark | `lib/client.js` 的 `GAName` | | 品牌色 | `lib/client.js` 的 `BRAND_COLOR` / `FAVICON_COLOR`（light/dark 成對） | | favicon | `lib/client.js` 的 `faviconHref()` | ## 隨附技能（bundled skills） 14 個技能隨包註冊（`ctx.skills.registerProvider`，bundled rank 600——用戶自帶同名技能一律優先）： - `ga-identity`：以 General Agentics 身分自介與簽署產出 - 13 個方法論技能 vendored 自 [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)（MIT，逐字未改）： `brainstorming`、`writing-plans`、`executing-plans`、`test-driven-development`、`systematic-debugging`、`verification-before-completion`、`writing-skills`、`diagnosing-superpowers`、`subagent-driven-development`、`dispatching-parallel-agents`、`requesting-code-review`、`receiving-code-review`、`finishing-a-development-branch` ——15 個上游技能取 13；`using-superpowers`（其「任何回應前必查技能」規則與 `ga-identity` 的身分主導權衝突）與 `using-git-worktrees`（團隊 git 工作流）刻意不入，理由見 `skills/THIRD-PARTY.md`。 **感謝**：Jesse Vincent (obra) 與 superpowers 貢獻者；詳見 `skills/THIRD-PARTY.md`。 ## 精選插件（curated plugins） 隨套件安裝並自動啟用（`dependencies` ＋ `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert row；row id 一律 `ga-` 前綴，避免與用戶直裝的同名插件撞 id）。 | 插件 | 功能 | 需要什麼才會「看得見」 | |---|---|---| | `dshmarket` | 插件市集 | 設定 → Plugin Market | | `dsh-better-sidebar` | 側欄：檔案樹／編輯器／變更／任務／側聊 | 基本即有；`agentOpenTools` 與 sentinel tab 已預設開啟（只新增，不動其他 tab） | | `dsh-comments` | **自家工具**：劃選回覆片段、逐段點評，可一鍵把全部點評組裝成訊息送回 | 立即可用 | | `dsh-promptimizer` | **自家工具**：一鍵用當前選定模型改寫草稿 prompt（Light/Standard/Deep） | 需要可用的模型 | | `dsh-sentinel` | 排程監看面板（BSD-3-Clause，隨包附授權） | 立即可用；better-sidebar 的 sentinel tab 已預設開啟 | | `dsh-cost-meter` | 會話費用統計 | 每條回覆的用量行（本套件已預設 `performanceUsage: detailed`） | | `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` | 回覆內嵌互動 UI 卡片 | 本套件已預設區塊位置與提示 | | `dsh-context` | 上下文洞察／管理 | 本套件已預設開啟 fleet 分頁 | | `@liustack/modsearch` | 免費網頁＋X 搜尋聚合 | 本套件已接管 `web` 的 `searchProvider`（用戶 profile patch 可改回） | | `@ricardochen1996/dsh-browser-use` | 瀏覽器自動化 | **需 `uv`**（首次自動建 Python venv ~25MB） | | `@xmanrui/dsh-im` | 微信／飛書／企微／釘釘／TG／Slack… 橋接 | **需 IM 應用憑證**，否則只有背景日誌 | | `@liustack/modlens` | 給純文字 LLM 的視覺能力 | **需 Antigravity CLI**（未隨包） | | `dsh-mobile` | 手機／局域網安全訪問、目錄選擇器 | 佔用一個 TCP 埠（預設 3443）；同機第二個 gateway 會撞埠 | ## DSH 版本相容性（0.2.1 的安裝閘門） DSH 0.2.1 起，安裝時會先讀插件的 manifest 檢查相容性（`dsh-app-boot` 的 plugin-compatibility）：**有 `engines.dsh` 就只看它，否則檢查它對 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 的 peer 範圍**，用 `semver.satisfies(..., {includePrerelease:true})` 判斷。**只要有一個插件不合格，整個安裝會被拒絕並回滾**。 因此本套件： - 宣告 `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2"`（只用 `>=`，才不會把 rc 版擋掉） - 精選清單以 **0.2.1 可接受的版本**為 floor；發佈前用 `npm run check-dsh-compat` 核對 - **兩個插件目前不納入**（在 0.2.1 上無法安裝，非我們能修）： | 插件 | 原因 | |---|---| | `@michengai/dsh-agency-agents` | 所有已發佈版本的 peer 只列出 0.1.x 的 dsh，沒有任何版本被 0.2.1 接受 | | `dsh-web-search-pro` | 0.2.x 全部封頂 `<0.2.1-0`；唯一能過的是 0.1.2（降級，故不納入） | 需要它們時可手動安裝並自負風險： ```sh dsh plugin --profile

allow-version @ --dsh-version 0.2.1-rc.2 --accept-risk ``` 上游發佈相容版本後，把 row 加回 `cordis.patch.yml` 即可（`test/bundle-manifest.test.mjs` 會檢查依賴與 row 是否一致）。 ## 設定面板（Settings → General Agentics） 設定側欄多一個 **General Agentics** 分頁，回答「這個 bundle 到底裝了什麼、要不要更新」，並在介面上分成五個區塊： 1. **狀態總覽**：版本、狀態 chip（已是最新／N 項待處理／可更新）、檢查時間，以及「重新檢查」 2. **需要注意**：缺少外部依賴（`uv` 等，附一鍵複製修法）、未提供（可複製安裝指令）、直裝重複 3. **更新**：一鍵更新（二次確認）＋進度計時＋`aria-live`，失敗顯示 `code` 與原因，並有可複製的手動指令 4. **精選插件**：依用途分組（搜尋／介面／行動／自家／通訊），可篩選（全部／有新版／需注意／未提供）與搜尋；每列可展開看宣告範圍、已裝與 registry 版本、落後原因、複製安裝指令與 npm 連結 5. **隨附技能**與**前置條件**（無法隨 npm 套件提供的項目，標示已就緒／需自行確認） 首次開啟會有一張可關閉的「這個 bundle 給了你什麼」引導卡。面板語言**跟隨瀏覽器**（zh/en，可用 `localStorage['general-agentics/lang']` 覆寫），所有字串來自兩份鍵集相同的字典。 - **bundle 版本**：目前版本 vs registry 最新版（本地開發版領先 registry 時會標「本地版本領先 registry」而不是誤報有更新） - **13 個精選插件**：每個的宣告範圍、**實際已安裝版本**、registry 最新版，以及 `有新版` / `最新` / `未提供` / `直裝重複` 標記（後者代表這個 profile 又直裝了一份，會啟用兩次） - **14 個隨附技能**：名稱清單 - **更新**：一鍵更新走 profile 的 plugin manager（`installBundle`）；沒有 manager 的 profile 會顯示可複製的手動指令（**desktop profile 的 CLI 被 Electron 獨佔，請用面板按鈕**）。`link:`／`file:` 安裝會額外提示「更新會改用 registry 版本」 - **精選插件怎麼更新**：插件是上游 npm 套件的依賴，**bundle 升版本身不會移動插件版本**（pnpm 以 lock 為準）；只有當該次發佈**提高了 floor**（例如 `^0.68.1` → `^0.72.0`）時，一鍵更新才會把插件一起帶上去。發佈前用 `npm run check-upstream` 看差距，提 floor 後必須在乾淨 profile 驗證過再發（0.x 的 minor 依 semver 可能不相容） 資料來自 host 半註冊的唯讀端

plugins.description: Virtual desktop computer use for DeepSeek Harness with a live right sidebar and a virtual pointer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-computer-user

**Virtual-desktop computer use for DeepSeek Harness.** The agent sees your screen
in the right sidebar and its mouse acts on that snapshot — not on your real
cursor. It plays its own game; you keep your computer.

A fork of [jing-hy/computer-user](https://github.com/jing-hy/computer-user) that
adds the half it was missing: a visualization.

---

## The problem

Upstream `computer-user` gives a text-only model genuine control of a Windows
machine. It works, but you cannot see any of it:

- `computer_screenshot` writes a PNG to a temp directory **for the model's eyes
  only**. You never see what it is looking at.
- `computer_click` moves **your actual cursor** and clicks. While the agent
  works, the machine is not yours.
- You find out what happened afterwards, from the conversation.

For a long autonomous task that is a bad deal: you cannot tell whether it is
about to click the wrong thing, and you cannot use your own computer meanwhile.

## What this fork changes

**A live snapshot in the right sidebar.** Every capture the agent makes is
published to a dockable panel: the screen, the agent's virtual pointer moving
across it, click ripples, the text it types, the keys it presses. You watch the
work in progress.

**Actions land on the snapshot by default.** `link_mode: virtual` means the
agent still screenshots, still "clicks", still "types" — but that pointer lives
on the panel. Nothing reaches Win32 `SendInput`, so your cursor, your focus, and
your window layout are untouched. The agent plays in the picture; your desktop
is yours.

**Flip to real when you mean it.** One toolbar button (or the settings card)
switches `link_mode` to `real`, and now the Win32 path runs — with the panel
still mirroring what happens, so `real` mode is visible rather than a hijack.

**You can point at things.** Click anywhere on the snapshot, optionally with a
note, and that becomes a queued instruction with an exact screen coordinate. The
agent reads them through `computer_get_vision`, so "click *this*" stops being a
description problem.

**The agent gets numbers, not just a picture.** `computer_get_vision` reports the
captured size, the virtual-screen origin, the capture scale, the current
pointer, the frame's age, and your pending hints. Combined with the panel, the
look-act-verify loop closes on both sides.

## How the two halves fit together

| | upstream | this fork |
|---|---|---|
| capture | PNG to disk for the model | **same PNG, published to the sidebar** |
| pointer | real cursor via SendInput | **virtual pointer on the snapshot** (default) |
| typing / keys | real keystrokes | **drawn on the snapshot** (default) |
| verification | screenshot again, read it | **screenshot again, watch it** |
| user input | none | **click the snapshot to point, with a note** |
| real control | always | **opt-in, one switch** |

Everything upstream did is still here: all nine `computer_*` tools, the four run
modes, `/computer` approval, the settings namespace, the output guard that
bounces tool calls written as prose, and the bundled PowerShell that needs no
native module.

## Install

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build          # → lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser)
```

Then add the package to your DSH profile as a plugin dependency. The bundle patch
in `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row and sets the defaults:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-computer-user
      name: '@asun-labs/dsh-plugin-computer-user'
      config:
        mode: manual
        link_mode: virtual
```

## Settings

Settings → 电脑操作. The two that matter sit at the top:

**动作落点 (link_mode)**

- `virtual` *(default)* — mouse and keyboard only affect the sidebar snapshot.
  Your desktop and cursor are untouched.
- `real` — Win32 `SendInput` drives this machine. The agent takes the real cursor.

**运行模式 (mode)**

- `disabled` — refuse every tool call.
- `readonly` — screenshot, cursor, vision reads, wait.
- `manual` *(default)* — acting tools need `/computer` approval in the conversation.
- `auto` — the model may call everything.

Advanced: capture interval (how often the panel refreshes), screenshot directory,
typing interval, scroll units, whether the AI may change its own modes, the
output guard, and debug logging.

## The panel

| control | what it does |
|---|---|
| 虚拟快照 / 实机接管 badge | which mode is live, at a glance |
| `→ real` / `→ virtual` | switch `link_mode` in one click |
| `−` / `＋` / `%` | zoom; `100%` is real 1:1, one panel pixel per snapshot pixel |
| 适应 (Fit) | whole snapshot, centred, **aspect ratio preserved** |
| 1:1 | original pixels, scrolled if it does not fit |
| 跟随 (Follow) | pan automatically to keep the virtual pointer visible |
| `⟳` | capture now; otherwise the panel refreshes on the configured interval |

Gestures: **left click** = point for the agent (with the note field, if you typed
one), **Shift+drag** = pan when zoomed in, **Ctrl/⌘+wheel** = zoom.

The snapshot is never stretched. It is scaled by whichever axis fits and centred
on the other, so the shapes you see are the shapes on screen — which is what
makes clicking it meaningful.

## Architecture

```
src/
  index.ts         plugin body — tools, routes, capture loop, settings, /computer
  tools.ts         the 12 computer_* tools, the mode gate
  session.ts       VirtualSession — the board the panel renders (frames, overlays, hints)
  ports.ts         DesktopPort: real (SendInput) vs virtual (record only)
  geometry.ts      screen ↔ frame ↔ panel transforms (pure, shared by both halves)
  client.tsx       the sidebar panel + the settings card
  ps.ts            bundled PowerShell runner (base64 JSON payload)
  capture.ps1      DPI-aware multi-monitor screenshot  (upstream, unmodified)
  input.ps1        Win32 SendInput mouse + keyboard    (upstream, unmodified)
tests/             geometry, session, tools, gate, output guard
```

The split that makes the fork work is `ports.ts`: a tool asks a `DesktopPort` to
click, and whether that means "really click" or "draw a click on the panel" is
one swap. `link_mode` changes which port is returned; nothing else in the tool
layer knows the difference. It also means the whole tool set is testable without
touching a real desktop — the tests do exactly that. The Host keeps only the
latest 24 generated panel previews and removes its generated screenshots on an
orderly shutdown. A screenshot path supplied explicitly by a tool caller is not
managed by this cleanup.

`geometry.ts` is shared verbatim by both halves, which is why a click you make on
the panel and a click the agent makes through `computer_click` resolve to the
same screen pixel instead of merely close to it.

## Requirements

Windows. Tested with DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`; the package also declares the earlier
`0.1.5` and `0.1.7` lines. Capture uses `System.Windows.Forms`/`System.Drawing` and input uses Win32
`SendInput`, both through the bundled PowerShell — no native module, no build
step, no external API. On other platforms the panel loads and reports that
capture and injection are unavailable.

## Attribution

Forked from [**computer-user**](https://github.com/jing-hy/computer-user) by
**jing-hy**, MIT licensed. The `computer_*` tool design, the run-mode gate, the
`/computer` approval flow, the settings namespace, the output guard, and both
PowerShell scripts come from that project; see [NOTICE](./NOTICE). The
visualization layer, the virtual/real port split, `computer_get_vision`,
`computer_set_link_mode`, and the sidebar panel are this fork's additions.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.description: DSH 外包：Codex 分配任务，DSH 桌面执行；可见会话、连续上下文、完成回调。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-waibao · DSH 外包

**Codex 分配任务，DSH 桌面执行；同一会话继续，完成后回来验收。**

[GitHub 源码](https://github.com/ericlee041769-hash/dsh-waibao) · [Gitee 源码](https://gitee.com/sensenlee/dsh-waibao) · [下载安装包与演示视频](https://github.com/ericlee041769-hash/dsh-waibao/releases/tag/v0.1.0)

把原本藏在命令行里的委派，放进看得见的 DSH 桌面工作区。

- **桌面可见**：会话出现在原生工作区和侧栏，正文、工具过程和用量都由 DSH 展示。
- **上下文续接**：后续任务重用保存的 session binding，接着原会话执行。
- **完成回调**：任务结束后通知发起任务的 Codex 聊天，交由 Codex 检查产物。
- **历史接入**：把已有 headless 会话加入桌面工作区，再继续工作。
- **保留模型**：使用已选 provider/model；续接时检查是否发生切换。

## 什么情况下有用

当你希望 Codex 负责拆解、评审和验收，DSH 接手实现或检查时：你能看见执行过程、减少重复交代背景，并在完成后继续推进。多轮功能开发、长时间测试和检查更适合这条流程；单轮简单问答的收益较小。

它也让两个产品各用现有模型和工具配置。费用由任务分工、上下文长度和实际模型计费共同决定。

## 安装

首版支持 **Windows、Node.js 24+**。已实测 DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.2.0-rc.2**；完成回调需要 Codex 桌面及已启用的 Codex App Tools。其他版本尚未验收。

从 [v0.1.0 发布页](https://github.com/ericlee041769-hash/dsh-waibao/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 下载 `dsh-waibao-0.1.0.tgz`，在 DSH 桌面“添加插件”中填入本地 `.tgz` 路径。也可以用 **DSH 桌面自带 CLI**：

```powershell
$dsh = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'D:\Downloads\dsh-waibao-0.1.0.tgz'
```

正常退出并重开 DSH。全局独立安装的旧版 `dsh` 无权管理桌面 profile，请使用上述桌面 CLI。插件遵循上游的 [bundle 安装规范](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.zh.md)。

安装 Codex 技能：

```powershell
$plugin = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-waibao"
node "$plugin\bin\install-skill.mjs"
node "$plugin\bin\cli.mjs" describe
```

在 Codex 新聊天中说：**“用 dsh-waibao 把这个任务委派给 DSH，完成后帮我验收。”**

技能安装器只写入 `~/.codex/skills/dsh-waibao/SKILL.md`（支持 `CODEX_HOME`）。更新插件后重跑安装器，刷新技能中的安装路径。

## 手动调用与续接

创建提示词文件，再写任务 JSON。以下为路径示例，替换成你的实际工作区：

```json
{
  "workspace": "D:\\code\\demo",
  "workspaceTitle": "外包演示",
  "title": "检查实现与测试",
  "requestId": "demo-round-1",
  "bindingPath": "D:/code/demo/work/dsh-session.json",
  "promptFile": "D:/code/demo/work/round1.txt"
}
```

```powershell
node "$plugin\bin\cli.mjs" run 'D:\code\demo\work\task.json'
```

续接时保留 `bindingPath`，使用新的 `requestId` 和提示词文件。不要复制历史正文、替换 session ID 或同时驱动同一会话。只有新会话可用 `selection: {provider, model, reasoningEffort}` 指定模型；默认采用桌面的当前选择。

`adopt <JSON>` 接受 `workspace`、`sessionId` 和可选 `workspaceTitle`。先确认旧 headless 进程已结束，并使用原始工作目录。接入本身不调用模型。

## 完成回调

技能会在 Codex 环境中调用 `bin/job.mjs run <job.json>`，登记原始聊天、执行命令和输出路径。进程结束后，通过本机 Codex App Tools 发出一次完成事件。无需定时器或轮询。

`job.mjs status <id>` 查看已有记录；`deliver <id>` 处理尚未投递的完成事件。投递结果不确定时先核对历史，拒绝盲目重发。应用关闭或 Codex 重启可能使已有连接失效。

## 数据与权限

插件通过带随机令牌的 Windows 本地命名管道通信，没有 HTTP 端口。连接记录与回调状态位于 `~/.dsh/dsh-waibao/`；`DSH_WAIBAO_DATA_DIR` 可将双方改到同一自定义目录。

提示词交给 DSH 原生 Agent，使用当前账号、模型、工具权限与审批策略；模型费用由该 provider 收取。绑定和输出由调用方写在任务工作区。令牌、完整日志、个人项目和会话数据不要提交到公开仓库。

断线不代表任务停止：客户端在收到 `done` 前断开会明确报错，重试前应检查桌面会话。忙碌会话、重复 requestId、未知 session 和工作区不匹配会被拒绝。

## 缓存与费用

复用 session 能保持任务连续性。实际缓存命中率还取决于模型路由、历史变化、压缩与服务商规则。插件不承诺固定命中率或节省比例；桌面显示和命令行 usage 是可核查的实际用量。

## 开发

运行时零第三方依赖，直接加载 ESM 源码，无需构建：

```sh
npm run check
npm test
npm pack
```

`src/host.mjs` 负责原生会话和 IPC；`bin/cli.mjs` 负责任务绑定；`bin/job.mjs` 负责完成记录和回调；`src/paths.mjs` 让两端共享同一数据路径；`bin/read-run.mjs` 读取有界摘要；技能负责调用流程。没有另建聊天 UI、会话数据库或轮询服务。

演示视频源码和重新渲染说明见 [promo/README.md](promo/README.md)。[社区发布文案](docs/community-post.md)和[视频标题与简介](docs/video-description.md)可直接使用。

MIT License。社区插件，项目名称中的 DSH 和 Codex 用于说明兼容产品。

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: DSH 插件：用 MiniMax（海螺）TTS 朗读对话流里的 assistant 消息（手动播放 + 灵动模式）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-minimax-tts

把对话流里的 assistant 消息朗读出来 —— 只适配 MiniMax（海螺）TTS 的 DSH 插件。

两半边纯 ESM JavaScript，无 TS、无构建步骤。本文件属于**宿主半边**（`index.js` / `lib/**` / 路由与缓存）；
`client.js`（消息上的朗读按钮）由客户端半边交付。

- v1 = **手动模式**可用（点一下读一条 + 设置页可调参数）。
- v1.1 = **灵动模式**宿主半边落地：`emotionTts` 三态 + 行级 `role`，Agent 侧多出技能 `emotion-tts` 与工具
  `emotion_tts`，交出的朗读稿进 `pending/<session>.json`，播放按钮**认领即消费 + 回放账本**（见下「灵动模式」）。
- 不做：声音克隆、声音设计、双音色 `timbre_weights`、变声 `voice_modify`、音乐与音效、流式合成、
  字幕落盘、边生成边朗读。

## 安装

profile 是 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>`。三种等价做法：

- 「插件」页里添加本仓库目录（会写成 `link:` 依赖）；
- 或直接编辑 profile 的 `package.json`，把 `"dsh-minimax-tts": "link:<本仓库绝对路径>"` 加进 `dependencies`；
- 再把它加进 **bundle 清单**（`dsh plugin add` 只写依赖，**`dsh.profile.bundles` 才是挂载清单**），
  然后在 profile 目录跑一次包管理安装，最后重启 DSH。

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-minimax-tts": "link:<本仓库绝对路径>"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["dsh-minimax-tts"]
    }
  }
}
```

bundle 补丁层（`cordis.patch.yml`）只插入宿主半边一行；客户端半边由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 声明，
不需要另开一行。`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 与 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 由宿主运行时提供，**故意不声明成依赖**。

## 配置

装完在 DSH 的**「设置 → 插件」**里找到本插件改字段（keyed 插件设置页，不占通用设置入口；
`Config` 的字段名与默认值见下），也可以 `POST /dsh-minimax-tts/config`
用 `{ patch }` 浅合并（`voices` 是整体替换）。落盘在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-minimax-tts/config.json`（`0600`，原子写；
首次变更前留一份 `config.json.bak`；文件损坏时优先回退 `.bak`，没有 `.bak` 就降级默认值并把损坏原文留作
`.bak` 证据）。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.minimax.cn` | 也可 `api.minimaxi.com` / `api.minimax.io` |
| `apiKey` | `''` | 兜底顺序：`config.apiKey` → 环境变量 `MINIMAX_API_KEY` → `~/.dsh/.env` |
| `model` | `speech-2.8-hd` | `speech-2.8-hd` / `speech-2.8-turbo` / 2.6 / 02 / 01 系列 |
| `voices` | `[{ id: 'female-shaonv', label: '', isDefault: true }]` | `isDefault` 那条是默认音色 |
| `previewText` | `你好，这是一段语音合成测试，听到说明朗读功能已经正常工作了。` | 设置页「试听」的默认文本（客户端可持久化）；空串回落默认值，**不进缓存 key** |
| `emotion` | `''` | 空 = 不传，由模型按文本自选；`whisper` 在 `speech-2.8` 系列不可用（上游 2013），`fluent` 不受限 |
| `speed` / `vol` / `pitch` | `1` / `1` / `0` | 区间 `[0.5, 2]` / `(0, 10]` / `[-12, 12]` |
| `sampleRate` | `32000` | `8000/16000/22050/24000/32000/44100`（不在集合里回退默认） |
| `bitrate` | `128000` | `32000/64000/128000/256000`（仅 mp3） |
| `format` | `mp3` | `mp3/pcm/flac/wav/pcmu_raw/pcmu_wav/opus` |
| `channel` | `1` | `1` 或 `2` |
| `languageBoost` | `auto` | MiniMax `language_boost`，设置页为**下拉选框**（40 种语言 + `auto` + 「不增强」）。`auto`＝模型自动识别语言；**选「不增强」＝请求里不带该字段**（官方默认 `null`＝不增强）；粤语音色必须 `Chinese,Yue`；`speech-01`/`02` 不支持 `Persian`/`Filipino`/`Tamil` |
| `cleanup` | `{ days: 30, maxItems: 500, maxBytes: 524288000 }` | 三项**任一超限**即淘汰；**填 0 = 该项不限制** |
| `advance` | 全 `false` / `''` / `[]`，`outputFormat: 'hex'` | 装完只调一次，设置页默认折叠；v1 只会用到 `pronunciationTone` / `latexRead` 等文本侧开关 |
| `emotionTts` | `{ scope: 'off' }` | 灵动模式三态：`off` 两处都不注册 / `preset` 只有 preset 行注册 / `global` 全局行注册；非法值回落 `off` |
| `role` | `full` | **行级**角色（写在那一行的 `config` 里）：`full` 挂 9 条路由，`skill-only` 只挂技能与工具、不挂路由 |

**音色怎么挑**：内置默认音色 `female-shaonv` 一个，够用就直接用；想换或想加，就去官方试听页
<https://www.minimax.cn/audio> 听过、复制 `voice_id`，手填进 `voices` 列表（设置页或 `POST /config` 整体替换），
`isDefault: true` 的那条就是默认音色。设置页会拿账号音色目录给每条音色标一个**中性的「目录内 / 目录外」**，
但**目录只作提示，绝不阻止**加入、移除、设为默认或合成：官方试听页能听、能真实合成的音色，`POST /v1/get_voice`
未必返回（例如 `Japanese_energetic_anime_girl_vv1`），查错了算上游的，合成是否可用以真实朗读为准。

## 使用

客户端半边只做两件事：每条 assistant 消息上的**朗读按钮**，和「设置 → 插件」里的**参数页**。

- 朗读按钮是**一颗按钮**：未播放时是播放图标，播放中变成停止图标（点它即停），图标与尺寸照抄宿主
  native `MessageIconActions`（28×28、`--dsw-radius-sm`、hover 只换底色不改圆角）；同一时刻只播一条，
  播新的会自动停掉上一条。
- 设置页包括音色 / 模型 / 情绪 / 语速 / 音量 / 音高 / 格式 / 采样率 / 码率 / 声道 / 语言增强下拉 /
  高级参数折叠区，以及**试听**：试听文本会持久化（重开设置页不重置），旁边有「恢复默认」；
  「打开缓存目录」按钮直接调系统文件管理器打开缓存目录。音色行标出「目录内 / 目录外」（中性提示、不拦截任何操作），
  卡片标题行显示「上次检查：<时间>」（失败时为「检验失败：<错误码>」并保留上一轮标记），
  「刷新音色目录」按钮在下面输入行、紧挨「加入列表」（同一不换行按钮组，不会被拆到两行）（见上文「音色怎么挑」）。

走本半边下面这些路由。宿主半边也能独立验证：

```sh
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-minimax-tts/synthesize \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text":"你好，这是一次试听。","preview":true}'
# => {"ok":true,"url":"/dsh-minimax-tts/audio/<sha256>.mp3","cached":false,"chars":9,"totalChars":9}
```

把返回的 `url` 拼在 DSH 的 origin 后面就能播；命中缓存时 `cached: true` 且**不发起任何上游请求**。
`preview: true` 的条目（试听）与正式条目同池，但淘汰时**优先删 preview**。

| 方法 | 路径 | 请求 → 响应 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/dsh-minimax-tts/synthesize` | `{ text, params?: { voiceId, model, emotion, speed, vol, pitch, format, sampleRate, bitrate, channel, languageBoost }, preview? }` → `{ ok, url, cached, chars, totalChars }` |
| GET | `/dsh-minimax-tts/config` | → `{ ok, config }` |
| POST | `/dsh-minimax-tts/config` | `{ patch }` → `{ ok, config }` |
| GET | `/dsh-minimax-tts/audio/<hash>.<ext>` | → 音频二进制 + `content-type`（`x-tts-chars` 是这条音频的字数） |
| GET | `/dsh-minimax-tts/cache` | → `{ ok, bytes, count, hits, totalChars, items }` |
| POST | `/dsh-minimax-tts/cache/clear` | `{ all?: true }` → `{ ok, removed }` |
| POST | `/dsh-minimax-tts/cache/open` | → `{ ok: true, dir }`（在系统文件管理器里打开缓存目录）；打不开时 `{ ok: false, error: 'open-failed', dir }` |
| GET | `/dsh-minimax-tts/pending` | `?sessionId=` → `{ ok, items }`（只读；`emotionTts.scope='off'` 时恒为 `[]`） |
| POST | `/dsh-minimax-tts/pending/claim` | `{ sessionId, messageId? }` → `{ ok, item: { text, params, createdAt } \| null }`；先查**回放账本**（同一条消息重复问拿回同一份稿子），未命中才取走并删除队首条目；`GET /pending/claim` → 405 |

路由**只放行本机回环**请求（远程地址 + `Host`/`Origin` 同源校验），其余一律 `403 loopback-only`。

错误判定只看 MiniMax 的 `base_resp.status_code` —— HTTP 200 也可能是业务错误：非 0 时把
`status_code` / `status_msg` 透传成 `{ ok: false, error: 'minimax-error', statusCode, statusMsg }`；
另外还有 `api-key-missing`、`empty-after-clean`、`text-too-large`、`empty-audio`。

## 灵动模式（Agent 侧）

「灵动模式」让 Agent 把**这轮发给你的那段正文**登记成朗读稿：正文保持干净，`text` 用同一段话、只加朗读标记（词句不变）；念不念、什么时候念，仍由人点播放按钮决定。

- `emotionTts.scope` 三态：`off`（默认）宿主两处都不注册，Agent 完全看不见这个能力；`preset`（白名单）只有
  `role: skill-only` 的 preset 行注册技能 `emotion-tts` 与工具 `emotion_tts`；`global` 时全局行注册同一对
  技能/工具（所有会话可见）。
- 两类行靠 `role` 分工：全局行（`cordis.patch.yml` 插入的那行，默认 `role: full`）照旧挂 9 条路由；
  `role: skill-only` 的行**不挂任何路由**，只出技能与工具 —— 两行共享同一份状态目录，路由不会重复注册。
- 想开白名单：给自己 agent preset 的行列表加一行（与现有行同级），再把 `emotionTts.scope` 设成 `preset`：

  ```yaml
  - id: dsh-minimax-tts-skill
    name: 'dsh-minimax-tts'
    config: { role: skill-only }
  ```

  行里的插件按 profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-minimax-tts` 符号链解析（装好这个插件后就有）。
- 技能正文由插件代码供给（`lib/skill.js`），**不落盘 SKILL.md / `<name>.md`**：指一个目录也绕不过 `scope` 闸门。
  正文按当前配置拼出模型、可用音色与参数区间（emotion / voiceId / speed / vol / pitch / languageBoost）。
- 正文口径：**可见正文不写朗读标记**（`(laughs)`、`<#0.3#>`、`(chu3)(li3)` 只出现在 `text` 里）；`text` 与正文**词句逐句相同**，
  只允许加标记或把数字/单位/缩写写成念法；正文里念不了的内容（代码块/表格/长清单）可只收能念的句子并在回执里说明。
  想让 Agent 每轮都登记，在人格（系统提示）里加一句即可，例如「发言结束后，用 `emotion-tts` 把这段正文按原词句登记为待播」——
  技能正文已按这个口径写，不加也不会误用；不登记也不算错（播放按钮念可见正文）。
- 工具只登记、不合成：`text`（必填，≤10000 字符）+ `emotion` / `voiceId` / `speed`(0.5–2) / `vol`(0.01–10) /
  `pitch`(-12–12) / `languageBoost`（枚举＝设置页下拉里除「不增强」外的 41 项，粤语音色必须 `Chinese,Yue`），
  稿子原子写进 `pending/<session>.json`，同 session 后写覆盖前一条；取不到会话 id 时降级写
  `pending/current.json`。工具不触网、不算缓存。越界值或不认识的枚举值会被工具**直接拒绝**（不夹值），
  省略某个参数＝用设置页的值。
- 播放按钮点击时先 `POST /pending/claim {sessionId, messageId}`：命中就用稿子自己的 `text` + `params` 合成（Agent 给的
  参数按同名覆盖设置页参数），未命中才退回「消息可见文本 + 设置页参数」。
- 队列仍是一次性消费（同一份稿子不会被两条消息各播一次），但**同一条消息会被记进回放账本**：换音色、改参数后回来
  再点播放，用的还是 Agent 那份稿子，只是按当前设置页重新合成（缓存 key 含参数，换音色必然重新生成）。

## 文本清洗

朗读的是**清洗后**的文本（纯函数在宿主半边，客户端不重复实现）：去掉代码块与行内代码、URL、文件路径、
emoji、表格分隔行等噪声；保留 `(sighs)`、`<#0.8#>（停顿/语速标记）`、`(chu3)(li3)`（拼音标注）这类朗读指令。
清洗后为空就直接返回 `empty-after-clean`，不请求上游也不落缓存。

## 状态目录与缓存

```
$DSH_HOME/dsh-minimax-tts/
├── config.json          0600，原子写；首次变更前的快照 config.json.bak
├── cache/
│   ├── index.json       { version, items: { <key>: { file, ext, bytes, chars, model, voiceId, createdAt, lastHitAt, hits, preview } }, hits, totalChars }

└── pending/<session>.json   灵动模式的待播稿（每 session 至多一条，被认领后删除）
```
