plugins.readme_text: # dsh-image2-tool ![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin?display_name=tag&sort=semver&label=release) ![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-image2-tool?label=npm) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-image2-tool?label=downloads) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-339933?logo=node.js&logoColor=white) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-0078D4) ![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1-4B5563) ![Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-8B5CF6) **Language**: [中文](README.md) · English **社区插件标签**：`dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis` · `bundle` · `text-to-image` · `image-to-image` · `image-generation` · `ai-image` · `image-relay` · `openai-compatible` · `inline-media` · `web-ui` · `tool` 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 加上「一句话生成图片」和「拿参考图改图」的能力：接你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站，生成的图**直接内联显示在对话里**。 ![dsh-image2-tool 横幅](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin/main/docs/images/banner.jpg) --- ## 亮点 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 一行安装 | 官方通用方式 `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool`，重启后工具表出现 `image2_generate` | | 自己的中转站 | 文生图走 `POST /images/generations`，图生图走 `POST /images/edits`，同时支持 `b64_json` 与图片 URL 两种返回 | | 参考图引导 | 给 `image` 传一张本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP，角色一致性、画风与配色远比纯文字描述稳 | | 图形化配置 | 侧边栏 Plugins 页内置设置行（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 字段），也可直接写 `cordis.patch.yml` | | 视觉自检 | 生成后用原生 `read_image` 复核真实文件，不把「接口成功」当成「视觉合格」 | | 内联预览 | 自动带上 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)，图片直接渲染在回复下方，无需点开卡片 | | 克制默认 | `autoGenerateAssets` 默认 `false`，普通开发任务不会悄悄花掉生图额度；输出被限制在会话目录内 | ## 使用示例 下面两张图来自一次真实会话：让 Agent「生成一张 GPT 化龙指导器的形象」，它自己挑参考图、比对版本、迭代出成品。 **对话里长这样** —— 生成过程、参考图、版本对比都在回复里，图片由内联预览直接渲染，不用点开任何卡片（长图，可点开看全）： **最终结果** —— 该会话产出的成品（864 × 1152）： > 复现方式：装好插件后直接对 Agent 说「生成一张 XXX 的图」即可。`autoGenerateAssets` 保持默认 `false` 时，只有你明确要求才会生图。 ## 参考图引导（图生图） 只要调用里带上 `image`，插件就改走 `POST /images/edits`： ```jsonc { "prompt": "保持这个角色设定，改成少女比例，正常七头身，不要 Q 版", "image": "imagegen-output/reference.jpg", // 相对会话目录或绝对路径 "aspectRatio": "3:4", "filename": "result.jpg" } ``` | 参数 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `prompt` | 必填。要生成或要改什么 | | `image` | 可选。本地参考图路径（PNG/JPEG/WebP，≤ 20 MB）。给了就走图生图，不给就是文生图 | | `filename` | 可选。输出文件名，不含目录 | | `size` | 可选。形如 `1024x1024`。只认 `aspect_ratio` 的中转站会忽略它 | | `aspectRatio` | 可选。形如 `3:4`、`16:9`，以 `aspect_ratio` 字段发出。中转站忽略 `size` 时用它控制构图 | 细节： - 参考图按**魔术字节**判定真实类型，不信任扩展名；文件不存在、不是普通文件、超过 20 MB、或不是受支持的图片格式，都在**发出请求之前**就报错，不浪费额度。 - 上传用 `multipart/form-data`，`Content-Type` 与 boundary 交给 `FormData` 处理。 - 中转站若不接受 `response_format`，把 `responseFormat` 设为空字符串即可不发该字段。 ## 安装 ### 官方通用方式（推荐） ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool ``` 把 `` 换成你常用的 profile 名（例如 `web`、`default`）。装完**重启 DSH**，工具表里就会出现 `image2_generate`。 ### 其它等价方式 ```powershell # 从 GitHub Release 下载的 tgz dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-image2-tool-0.4.1.tgz # 直接从 GitHub 仓库安装 dsh plugin --profile add github:544244857/dsh-image2-plugin # 本地源码目录（开发调试） dsh plugin --profile add ./plugins/deepseek-harness-image2 ``` 需要新建一个独立 profile 时： ```powershell dsh --profile image2-demo --from-default-profile web --dump-config ``` ## 配置 两种方式等价、可互换，**二选一**即可。 **① 图形界面**：侧边栏 → Plugins → `dsh-image2-tool` → `image2` 行，逐项填写（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 密钥字段），保存即写回当前 profile 的 Cordis patch。 **② 配置文件**：`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - id: image2 name: dsh-image2-tool config: baseUrl: https://your-image-relay.example.com/v1 model: grok-imagine-image-2.0 apiKeyEnv: IMAGE2_API_KEY autoGenerateAssets: false outputDir: imagegen-output timeoutMs: 180000 responseFormat: b64_json ``` | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `baseUrl` | 中转站地址（OpenAI 兼容，含 `/v1`） | | `model` | 模型名，**必须**是该中转站 `/v1/models` 里真实存在的名字，否则调用返回 404 | | `apiKeyEnv` | API key 的**环境变量名**（不是 key 本身） | | `apiKey` | 设置页里的遮蔽字段；非空时优先于 `apiKeyEnv`，后者作为兜底 | | `autoGenerateAssets` | 是否允许在软件开发任务中自动补齐缺失位图素材，默认 `false` | | `outputDir` | 输出目录，相对会话目录解析并强制不越界 | | `timeoutMs` | 单次请求超时 | | `responseFormat` | 向中转站索要的返回格式，默认 `b64_json`（图片字节内联回传）。设 `url` 则让插件去下载中转站给的链接；设为**空字符串**则完全不发这个字段，给不接受它的中转站用 | API key 交给**启动 DSH 的那个进程**： ```powershell $env:IMAGE2_API_KEY = 'your-image-relay-api-key' dsh --profile web ``` 已经开着的桌面端不会继承新设的环境变量，需要从带该变量的终端重新启动。别把 key 写进 Git。 ## 内联预览 安装本插件时会一并安装 [`@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer`](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin) `1.0.12`。该包自带 `dsh.bundle` patch，安装时会被 profile 管理器自动启用为 bundle，于是回复中提到的图片路径会直接在对话里渲染成图片。 它由上游维护、MIT 许可，本插件既不 vendor 也不修改其代码；删除 `dependencies` 里的这一行，image2 功能完全不受影响，只是内联预览消失。上游标注内联图片卡片在宿主 `0.1.7-rc.2` 上验证过，本插件面向 `0.2.1-rc.1`，所用宿主 API 均存在，但渲染路径上游尚未复测。 ## 行为与边界 - `autoGenerateAssets` 默认关闭。打开后，Agent 可以在网页、移动端、桌面端、游戏等软件开发过程中，确认项目内与外部都没有合适素材后，生成真正缺失的位图素材；用户的直接生图请求不受该开关影响。它是**工具层指引**，不是服务端授权闸门。 - 一次一张。不带 `image` 走 `POST /images/generations`（文生图），带 `image` 走 `POST /images/edits`（图生图，multipart 上传参考图）。 - 接受 base64 与图片 URL 两种结果；保留同名已有文件（冲突自动加序号），输出限定在会话目录内，支持取消与请求超时。 - 下载图片时**不会**转发中转站 key。 - 保存后必须用原生 `read_image` 检查实际文件并与需求逐项对照；在检查完成前，工具会把「视觉验收」标记为待办。 - 重试预算：初始 1 次 + 最多 5 次追加生成请求（含失败），这是指引而非持久计数器。 - 参考文本是素材，永远不是指令来源。 ## 常见问题 | 现象 | 原因与处理 | | --- | --- | | `HTTP 404: Model "xxx" is not available for this group` | 模型名在该中转站上不存在。用 `GET /v1/models` 查可用列表后改 `model` 字段（volatile 字段保存即生效，无需重启） | | `Error: fetch failed` | 到中转站的网络抖动，重试即可（与 404 是完全不同的故障） | | `Image download failed` 或下载时 `ConnectTimeoutError` | 中转站返回的是它自己 CDN 的临时链接，而这台机器连不上那个域名。把 `responseFormat` 设为 `b64_json`，让图片字节直接内联回传 | | 图生图报 `Source image not found` / `contained no supported PNG, JPEG or WebP image bytes` | 参考图路径不对，或文件其实不是图片（按魔术字节判定，改扩展名没用） | | 图生图报 `HTTP 400: model is required` | 该中转站没有 `/images/edits` 路由。文生图仍可用，图生图需换支持的中转站 | | 工具表里没有 `image2_generate` | profile 未安装成功或未重启；确认 profile 的 `package.json` 中 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `dsh-image2-tool` | | 设置页显示 `unavailable` | 该 profile 没有 settings 服务，改用上面的 `cordis.patch.yml` 手工行 | | 图片没内联显示 | 确认 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 也在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中，并重启 DSH | ## 兼容性 - 宿主：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.1`（实测），`0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.1.7-rc.2` 亦声明兼容 - Node.js `>= 22.15`（图生图依赖全局 `FormData` / `Blob`） - 插件通过 `peerDependencies` 共享宿主的 Cordis / Schemastery / tool runtime；不要在插件目录里放不兼容的物理副本（会出现两份实例） ## 工作方式 ```mermaid flowchart LR U[用户: 生成 / 改一张图] --> A[Agent] A -->|image2_generate| T[dsh-image2-tool] T -->|无 image: POST /images/generations| R[你的图片中转站] T -->|有 image: POST /images/edits| R R -->|b64_json 或 url| T T --> F[会话目录 / outputDir] F --> V[read_image 视觉自检] V --> P[内联预览渲染在回复下方] ``` - 工具面：`image2_generate`（宿主工具注册表） - 客户端面：`lib/client.js` 向 Plugins 页注入 `image2` 配置行 - bundle 面：`cordis.patch.yml` 插入插件行 `id: image2` - 测试：`test/smoke.js` 用本地假中转站覆盖两条通道，不需要网络与额度 ## 许可 MIT © 2026 544244857。依赖 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)（MIT，版权归其作者）。 --- English documentation: [README.en.md](README.en.md).

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. Relay and local network are two different setups, not two settings of one, so pick the one that matches wha

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that checks whether a voice note's transcript matches its audio (EmbeddingGemma cosine in a shared 768-d space) and searches the audio by meaning.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-escutar

A voice note has two records: the audio and the transcript. When the transcript
is wrong (wrong language, noise, text from another note), the mistake enters the
conversation silently. This plugin measures how far the transcript is from the
audio in the shared 768-dimensional space of EmbeddingGemma, and lets you search
the audio by meaning even when the transcript cannot be trusted.

It never transcribes again, never deletes and never rewrites a transcript: it
reads, measures and warns. Audio never leaves your machine.

## Install

Works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Open a terminal (PowerShell is fine on
Windows) and run:

```sh
# 1. pnpm — the harness manages profile plugins with it
npm install -g pnpm

# 2. add the plugin to your `web` profile
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-escutar

# 3. restart the harness: the bundle layer is read at boot
#    stop `dsh web` (Ctrl+C) and start it again
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-escutar`.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` also appends the
plugin row to the profile bundle list. That row is the only activation, and it
is applied at every boot. Nothing else to configure to install.

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command above (it resolves the repository again), then restart
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-escutar   # then restart
```

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the same range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` — the harness uses it to manage profile plugins.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself.
- **EmbeddingGemma CLI** reachable as an executable. The plugin calls
  `parecido <audio> <text> --simetrico` and
  `buscar <query> --indice <collection> --n <n>`. Point it with the
  `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN` environment variable or the `gemma` config key. If the
  binary is missing, the first measurement answers with an error naming that
  variable; the rest of the harness is unaffected.
- **A voice corpus**: one audio file and one transcript per note, sharing the
  id (`001.ogg` + `001.md`), either side by side or split into `audio/` and
  `texto/`.

The plugin itself has no native dependencies and no build step: plain ESM using
only Node built-ins.

## Usage

| Who | How | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| the agent | `conferir_transcricao` tool | check one note (`id`) or search the audio by meaning (`consulta`) |
| you | `/escutar` command | recent notes with a suspicious transcript |
| the agent | `agent/pre-step` hook | a short warning at the end of the conversation when a recent note is suspicious; nothing is appended when there is no suspicion, so it costs zero tokens |

```text
conferir_transcricao { "id": "001" }                               # is this note trustworthy?
conferir_transcricao { "consulta": "what did I say about backup" } # search the audio
/escutar                                                           # recent suspicious notes
```

### Verdicts

The verdict is the cosine between the audio vector and the transcript vector:

| Verdict | When |
|---|---|
| `suspeita` | cosine < **0.78** − 0.03 |
| `incerta` | inside the 0.03 band around the threshold |
| `confiavel` | cosine > 0.78 + 0.03 |
| `sem-medida` | no number (CLI failure, corrupt cache) |

A note on the edge of the threshold is reported as `incerta` on purpose: it is
neither an alarm nor a pass.

## Configuration

Every key falls back to a default, so a wrong config never breaks the plugin.
Override the row by `id` in your profile patch
(`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`; on Windows,
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`). A patch **replaces the
whole config of the row**, so restate every key you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: escutar
  config:
    corpus: '/path/to/voice-corpus'
    cache: '/path/to/discordancia.json'
    gemma: '/path/to/embeddinggemma'
    limiar: 0.78
    banda: 0.03
    maxAvisos: 2
    colecaoAudio: 'escutar-audio-gemma-v1'
    tempoLimiteMs: 120000
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `workspace` | package directory | base for the `corpus` and `cache` defaults |
| `corpus` | `<workspace>/corpus` | folder with the audio/transcript pairs |
| `cache` | `<workspace>/estado/discordancia.json` | cache read by `/escutar` and the hook |
| `gemma` | `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN`, then `~/.local/bin/embeddinggemma` (`embeddinggemma.exe` on Windows) | EmbeddingGemma CLI |
| `limiar` | `0.78` | cosine below which the transcript is suspicious |
| `banda` | `0.03` | uncertainty margin around the threshold |
| `maxAvisos` | `2` | maximum lines the hook appends; `0` disables it |
| `colecaoAudio` | `escutar-audio-gemma-v1` | index name used by `consulta` |
| `tempoLimiteMs` | `120000` | timeout for one CLI call |

The `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN` variable is used when `gemma` is not set in the
config. The package carries no machine-specific path.

### Index and cache

The plugin reads two artifacts; it does not build them:

1. **Audio index** (`colecaoAudio`, default `escutar-audio-gemma-v1`) — needed
   only by `conferir_transcricao` with `consulta`. Build it with the
   EmbeddingGemma CLI:

   ```sh
   embeddinggemma indexar /path/to/corpus/audio \
     --nome escutar-audio-gemma-v1 --ext ogg,opus,mp3,wav,m4a
   ```

   The audio encoder reads roughly the first 30 seconds of each file. If you
   need long notes sliced into windows, slice them before indexing.

2. **Discordance cache** (`cache`) — needed by `/escutar` and the hook. It is a
   JSON file written by your indexing pipeline:

   ```json
   {
     "gerado_em": "2026-10-13T12:00:00+00:00",
     "notas": [
       {
         "id": "001",
         "cosseno": 0.84,
         "transcricao": "first 200 characters of the transcript",
         "mtime": "2026-10-13T11:59:00+00:00",
         "mtime_texto": "2026-10-13T11:59:00+00:00",
         "janelas": [0.84],
         "segundos": 12
       }
     ]
   }
   ```

   `mtime` and `mtime_texto` are the modification times of the audio and the
   transcript when the cosine was measured. The tool checks them on every read:
   a cache without them, or older than the files on disk, is not served as
   current — the note is measured again on the spot. The hook only warns about
   notes whose `mtime` is within the last 48 hours.

Without an index or a cache, `conferir_transcricao` with `id` still works: it
measures the pair live (about 11 s to load the model, plus a few seconds per
note). `/escutar` and the hook stay quiet and say what is missing.

## Verification

After the restart, dump the profile config and look for the row:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

```text
# == dsh-escutar
- id: escutar
  name: dsh-escutar
```

Then ask the agent to call `conferir_transcricao` with `{"id": "001"}` (or run
`/escutar` when the cache exists). A live measurement returns the cosine, the
verdict and the transcript read from the cache.

From a source checkout, run the test suite:

```sh
npm test
```

The suite covers the verdict band, the CLI output parser, the cache freshness
guards, the command, the hook and the missing-binary error. It uses shell stubs,
so it runs on Linux and macOS; installing the plugin does not depend on it.

## Limits

- **The audio encoder reads about 30 seconds.** A long note is judged by a
  window, not by the whole recording.
- **A plausible but wrong transcript can pass.** Swapping one word for another
  word on the same subject may not move the cosine below the threshold. The
  signal catches gross errors: wrong language, noise, text from another note.
- **It does not judge the content.** It only says whether the audio and the text
  talk about the same thing in the same semantic space.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-power-menu 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加一个右上角电源按钮：点开只有 **关闭DSH** 和 **重启DSH** 两项，省得每次改完插件/配置还要去系统托盘里翻「退出」。 > Windows 专用 · 只支持 DSH Desktop · 纯本地 · 无外部依赖 · MIT > > ⭐ 如果这个小工具帮你省了点时间，欢迎点个 **Star** 支持一下，感谢～ ![dsh-power-menu 菜单截图](docs/screenshot.png) ## 为什么做这个 DSH Desktop 关窗口只是收进托盘，真正退出或重启要走托盘菜单；而改插件、改配置之后又经常需要重启一次。这个插件把这两步搬到会话标题栏右上角：一个电源键，两项操作，点完就走。 ## 功能 - **右上角电源按钮**：位于会话标题栏图标行最右侧，顺序为「布局 / 侧栏 / 电源」。 - **空会话也显示**：欢迎页和对话内使用同一个挂载位置，透明无底色，不会破坏主题，也不会出现两个按钮。 - **Windows 电源菜单风格**：白色圆角卡片、悬浮阴影、左侧线性图标 + 右侧文本，只有两项，不塞多余入口。 - **关闭DSH**：结束整个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用（Electron 主进程 + Host），不重新启动。 - **重启DSH**：结束整个应用，等旧端口释放后用原可执行文件重新拉起，窗口自动回来。 - **键盘可用**：`↑` / `↓` / `Home` / `End` 在两项间移动，`Enter` / 空格执行，`Esc` 关闭，点菜单外部也能关。 - **执行反馈**：点击后整页盖一层半透明遮罩，显示「正在关闭DSH…」/「正在重启DSH…」。 - **纯本地**：没有外部依赖、没有遥测；接口只监听本机回环地址，并做同源校验。 ## 安装 ### 方式 A：通过 DSH 插件管理器（推荐） 1. 打开 DSH Desktop 的 **插件 / 插件市场**。 2. 选择 **添加插件**，输入： ```text github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` 3. 安装完成后重启一次 DSH。 4. 在 **插件市场 → 已安装** 里确认 `dsh-power-menu` 处于「启用中」。 ### 方式 B：命令行安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` > `dsh` 是 DSH 自带的 CLI；如果 PATH 里没有，请用 DSH 安装目录里的 `dsh` / `dsh.cmd`。 ### 方式 C：本地开发安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/xichen-62/dsh-power-menu.git ``` 把插件链接进 desktop profile： ```powershell # Windows PowerShell $profileDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop" New-Item -ItemType Junction ` -Path "$profileDir\node_modules\dsh-power-menu" ` -Target "<你 clone 下来的目录>" ``` 然后在 `$profileDir\package.json` 里： - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-power-menu": "link:<你 clone 下来的目录>"` - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-power-menu"` 重启 DSH 生效。这个插件没有构建步骤，改完 `lib/` 里的文件重启即可。 ## 使用 1. 在会话标题栏右上角点电源图标。 2. 选择 **关闭DSH** 或 **重启DSH**。 3. 等待遮罩出现：关闭会退出应用；重启会在几秒后把窗口拉回来。 | 动作 | 结果 | 需要手动重开？ | | --- | --- | --- | | 关闭DSH | 结束整个桌面应用，不重新启动 | 是 | | 重启DSH | 结束应用 → 等端口释放 → 重新拉起 | 否，窗口自动回来 | > **注意**：点击即执行，没有二次确认。两个动作都会中断正在生成的回答、运行中的工具和后台任务。请在点之前保存手头的事情。 ## 工作原理 桌面版的进程树大致是： ```text Electron 主进程 └── Host 子进程（dsh-desktop-host，ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1） └── 本插件 ``` 插件跑在 Host 里，不能直接调用 Electron 的 `app.quit()` / `app.relaunch()`。所以 Host 只负责“交接”，真正的进程切换交给一个分离的 helper： ```mermaid flowchart LR UI[电源菜单] -->|POST| Host[Host 插件] Host -->|写 handoff + spawn| Helper[detached helper] Helper -->|taskkill /PID main /F
不带 /T| Main[Electron 主进程] Main -.->|IPC 断开| Host Host -->|application.shutdown| Disk[(会话日志落盘)] Helper -->|等端口释放 + 重新拉起| NewMain[新的 Electron 主进程] ``` 具体步骤： 1. Host 把交接信息写到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\`，用 `process.execPath` + `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 启动 `lib/helper.cjs`。 2. helper 等 1.2 秒，让 HTTP 应答先到浏览器。 3. helper 执行 `taskkill /PID <主进程> /F`，**刻意不带 `/T`**：只结束 Electron 主进程，让 Host 子进程有机会收到 IPC 断开。 4. Host 检测到断开后走自己的 `application.shutdown`，尽量把会话日志正常落盘。 5. 重启模式下，helper 等旧监听端口释放，清掉 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` / `DSH_DESKTOP_NODE_EXECUTABLE`，用原可执行文件重新拉起，并确认新进程存活；失败会重试，仍失败就弹窗提示手动打开。 6. 关闭模式下不拉起，等 Host 自己退出。 ### 接口 Host 半注册三个仅限本机回环的接口： ```text POST /api/dsh-power-menu/shutdown POST /api/dsh-power-menu/restart GET /api/dsh-power-menu/health ``` ## 安全 - 三个接口只接受回环地址（`127.0.0.1` / `::1`），校验 `Host` 必须是本机，拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`，带 `Origin` 时必须与本机同源。 - 没有鉴权令牌的第三方网页无法跨站触发关机/重启。 - 只支持桌面版；`dsh web` 下接口返回 409，不会去杀别的进程。 - 不收集任何数据，不联网，不写注册表；日志只写在本地 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\`。 ## 兼容性 - **系统**：Windows 10 / 11。插件依赖 `taskkill` 和 Electron 桌面进程树，其他系统未实现。 - **DSH**：在 **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2** 上实测通过（2026-10-18）。其他 0.2.x 版本可能可用，但未逐一验证。 - **Node**：跟随 DSH 自带的 Node（22+），无需单独安装。 ## 开发 ```text dsh-power-menu/ ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js Host 半：三个回环接口 + 交接调度 │ ├── client.js 浏览器半：window.__ModuleLoader__ bundle │ └── helper.cjs 分离的交接 helper ├── cordis.patch.yml bundle 插入层 ├── package.json ├── docs/screenshot.png └── README.md ``` - 客户端 bundle 不是普通 ESM，必须用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 格式；`dsh.client.inject` 声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`。 - 没有构建步骤，也没有运行时 npm 依赖。 - 提交前跑一次静态检查： ```bash npm run check ``` - 本地调试日志：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\power-menu.log` 和 `helper-*.log`。 ## 常见问题 **按钮没出现？** 确认插件处于「启用中」，并重启过一次 DSH；按钮只出现在有会话标题栏的页面。 **插件卡片上没显示介绍？** 本地开发（link 安装）的插件，卡片不读 `package.json` 的 `description`，需要在卡片上点「添加备注」自己填。这是 DSH 插件管理器的行为，不是插件的问题。 **重启后端口变了？** 正常。DSH Desktop 每次启动用随机端口（`--port 0`），插件只负责拉起新实例，不假设端口不变。 **点了没反应？** 看 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\` 下的日志；`dsh web` 环境会返回 409（仅支持桌面版）。 ## 卸载 - 插件管理器里移除 `dsh-power-menu`，或者从 profile 的 `dependencies` / `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉，再删掉 `node_modules` 里的链接。 - 可选：删除 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-power-menu\` 下的日志与交接文件。 - 重启 DSH 生效。 ## 更新日志 见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 xichen-62 ## 致谢 - 分离 helper 做进程交接、只结束主进程让 Host 优雅退出的思路，参考了 [dsh-desktop-restart](https://github.com/luoshuizhiwei/dsh-desktop-restart)（MIT）。本项目的实现是独立编写的。 - 菜单样式参考 Windows 电源菜单；图标为内联 SVG，无第三方图标库。 --- ## English A small DSH Desktop plugin that adds a power button to the top-right of the session header. It opens a Windows-style menu with exactly two actions: - **关闭DSH** — quit the whole desktop app (no relaunch). - **重启DSH** — quit and relaunch the app, so the window comes back automatically. Windows only, DSH Desktop only. No telemetry, no external dependencies; the three HTTP routes are loopback-only and same-origin fenced. Install from GitHub: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu ``` or add `github:xichen-62/dsh-power-menu` in the DSH plugin manager, then restart DSH. If this saves you some time, a ⭐ **star** is much appreciated. Thanks! MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Offline/online import-export and migration for DeepSeek Harness: profiles, plugins, skills, hooks, boards
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-portable

**Offline and online export/import for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): pack a whole working DSH home into one `.dshpkg` file and restore it on another machine — no network, no `pnpm install`, no manual path fixing.**

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) · [PUBLISHING](PUBLISHING.md) · [HANDOFF](HANDOFF.md)

---

## Why

Moving a DSH setup between machines is painful for three reasons:

1. A working profile is not one file. It is `profiles/<name>/` plus plugins **with their `node_modules`**, skills, hooks, task boards, storages, `AGENTS.md`, installed runtimes, and session logs.
2. Plugins are installed by pnpm from the network. An air-gapped machine, a locked-down corporate laptop, or a machine behind a dead proxy simply cannot run `dsh plugin add`.
3. Configuration files embed absolute paths (`C:\\Users\\me\\.dsh`, `/home/me/.dsh`) and the profile name, so copying the directory tree produces a DSH that boots with broken plugin paths.

dsh-portable solves all three: it packages a whitelist of roots into a single self-describing archive, refuses to walk outside that whitelist, and on import rewrites the six configuration files that actually contain machine-local paths.

## What goes into a package

| Root | Path | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| profile | `profiles/<name>` (config **and** plugin `node_modules`) | always |
| skills | `skills` | always |
| skills-disabled | `skills-disabled` | always |
| hooks | `hooks` | always |
| storages | `storages` | always |
| task boards | task-board / todo-board storage | always |
| browser host | dsh-builtin-browser-host | always |
| agent instructions | `AGENTS.md` | always |
| sessions | session logs | opt-in (`includeSessions`) |
| runtimes | downloaded runtimes | opt-in (`includeRuntimes`) |
| credentials | `.credentials.yaml` | **opt-in, off by default** |
| source maps | `*.map` inside the package | on (`includeSourceMaps`) |
| backups | `*.bak-*` next to config files | off (`includeBackups`) |

Anything not listed is never collected — there is no recursive "copy the whole home directory" step anywhere in the code.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-portable
```

The plugin has to be registered in the profile's own `package.json` — under `dependencies` **and** `dsh.profile.bundles`. Copying the package directory into `profiles/<profile>/node_modules` by hand looks like it works, until that profile runs `npm install` again: npm treats an undeclared package as extraneous and deletes it, and from then on the panel still renders its cards while every request answers `404`. `dsh plugin add` (or `npm install dsh-portable` inside the profile) writes both halves.

Then open **DSH settings → Portable Migration** (便携迁移). The panel is registered at `settings.section` with order 70, and is bilingual (zh/en) automatically.

Nothing is written to the DSH home until you press a button.

## Using the panel

Six cards:

1. **Export** — pick which optional roots to include, name the file, press Export. Packing runs in a worker thread; the progress bar streams entry counts, and a 20 MB package over ~14 000 entries takes about 3 seconds.
2. **Packages** — every `.dshpkg` under `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-portable/exports`, with size, entry count, manifest summary, and buttons: Import / Share / Delete (delete asks for confirmation).
3. **Upload** — drag or pick a `.dshpkg` and it is streamed to disk (`.part` then rename), so a 2 GB package never sits in memory.
4. **Import** — choose merge or replace, press *Preview* first (zero writes), then *Import* (explicit confirmation). The result lists applied items, rewritten files, backup location and warnings.
5. **LAN share** — publish a package as a one-shot download link (`http://<lan-ip>:<port>/d/<token>`). Defaults: **1 download, 60 minutes**, Range/HEAD supported, 410 on expiry or exhaustion. No relay, no cloud, no account.
6. **Backups** — the automatic pre-install backups (`<DSH_HOME>/portable-backups/<stamp>`), newest 5 kept.

## HTTP API

Base: `/dsh-portable/api`. All responses are JSON except the download route and the uploaded-file streaming route. Authentication reuses the host's `connection.requestRejection` fence (cookie + trusted origin), and falls back to a loopback-only check when that service is absent.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/status` | host info, package counts, active job, share server state |
| GET | `/profiles` | profiles present in this DSH home |
| GET | `/jobs` | recent jobs (export / preview / import) |
| GET | `/jobs/detail?id=` | one job with live progress |
| POST | `/jobs/cancel` | cancel a running job |
| POST | `/export` | start an export |
| GET | `/artifacts` | packages available for import |
| GET | `/artifacts/meta?id=` | manifest of one package |
| POST | `/artifacts/delete` | delete a package (confirmed in the UI) |
| PUT | `/upload/<name>` | stream an uploaded package to disk |
| POST | `/import/preview` | two-phase install, phase 1 (zero writes) |
| POST | `/import` | two-phase install, phase 2 (`confirm:true` required) |
| GET | `/backups` | automatic pre-install backups |
| POST | `/share` | mint a one-shot LAN download link |
| GET | `/share` | list live links |
| POST | `/share/remove` | revoke a link |

**Everywhere a package is named, the API takes an `artifactId` such as `exports:machine-20261018.dshpkg`, never a filesystem path.** `/`, `\\`, `..` and control characters are rejected, so neither the model nor a web page can use this plugin to read or write an arbitrary file.

## Model tools

Registered on the host tools service (silently skipped if the service is absent):

| Tool | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `portable_export` | package the current profile; returns id, size, entry count, per-root breakdown |
| `portable_inspect` | read a package manifest without importing |
| `portable_import` | **without `confirm:true` it is a dry run**; with it, performs the two-phase install |
| `portable_share` | mint a one-shot LAN link (1 download, 60 min) |

## CLI bootstrap (target machine without DSH)

```bash
# Windows
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 preview .\machine.dshpkg
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 install .\machine.dshpkg --yes

# macOS / Linux
sh bootstrap/install.sh preview ./machine.dshpkg
sh bootstrap/install.sh install ./machine.dshpkg --yes
```

Flags: `--home <dir>` (default `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`), `--profile <name>`, `--mode merge|replace`, `--keep <n>`, `--yes`. Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failure, `2` usage error. Without `--yes` on a non-TTY it refuses to write.

## Package format

`.dshpkg` is a gzipped tar. The manifest is the **first** entry:

```text
.dsh-portable/manifest.json
profiles/desktop/...
skills/...
hooks/hooks.json
...
```

```json
{
  "format": "dsh-portable/1",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-18T02:11:03.000Z",
  "tool": { "name": "dsh-portable", "version": "0.1.0" },
  "source": {
    "hostname": "WORKSTATION",
    "platform": "win32",
    "arch": "x64",
    "node": "v22.23.2",
    "dshHome": "C:\\Users\\me\\.dsh",
    "profile": "desktop"
  },
  "options": { "includeNodeModules": true, "includeSessions": false },
  "stats": { "entries": 13774, "files": 13482, "dirs": 292, "links": 0, "bytes": 20664511 },
  "roots": [{ "id": "skillsDisabled", "logical": "skills-disabled", "files": 13193, "bytes": 44615569 }]
}
```

Because it is a plain tar, `tar -xzf machine.dshpkg` works anywhere — you can inspect a package on a machine that has never heard of DSH. Long paths use PAX extended headers; the reader understands them incrementally, including PAX bodies that straddle chunk boundaries.

## Import pipeline

```text
preview:  read manifest ──► per-top counts + existsOnTarget ──► report (zero writes)
install:  extract to <home>/portable-staging/<stamp>
          ──► rename profile dir if the target profile name differs
          ──► rewrite local paths in the 6 config files
          ──► back up those 6 files to <home>/portable-backups/<stamp>
          ──► apply each top-level item (merge: add/overwrite; replace: move aside first)
          ──►

plugins.description: Resume input budget for DeepSeek Harness: compact a restored session's history before its first request when the projection is over the ceiling.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-resume-budget

恢复一个长会话时，在第一个请求发出**之前**检查预计输入；超过阈值就先压缩一次，再发请求。

> English: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that puts a configurable input ceiling on the first request of a restored session. When the projected prompt is at or above `thresholdTokens` (default `100000`), it compacts the history through the harness's official overflow path before that request is assembled. The check runs once per session per process, is skipped for sessions created in this process, and never fails a turn. It adds no storage, no background work, and no model calls of its own. MIT licensed, Node.js >= 22.

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell） | ✅ | 插件本身是纯 JS。仓库脚本全部有 `.mjs` 版本：`node scripts/check.mjs` / `node scripts/dev-link.mjs`。Windows 上 `dsh` 是 `dsh.cmd` 垫片，`check.mjs` 已经处理（用一条带引号的命令行经 shell 启动，绕开 Node 对 `.cmd` 的 EINVAL 和不搜 PATHEXT 导致的 ENOENT）。**不要用 `bash scripts/check.sh`**：Git `core.autocrlf=true` 会把它检出成 CRLF，bash 会报 `set: pipefail: invalid option name`。 |
| macOS（zsh） | ✅ | `node scripts/check.mjs`，或原有的 `bash scripts/check.sh`。`~` 展开、PATH 查找都走 POSIX 一路。 |
| Linux | ✅ | 同 macOS；这是 `scripts/*.sh` 最初针对的环境。没有平台相关的原生依赖。 |

实际验证环境：Windows 11 22H2 + Node 24.19.0（`engines` 下限是 22）。macOS/Linux 走的是同一套 `node:path`/`node:os`/`node:fs` API，但仓库没有 CI 矩阵，这两条是兼容性承诺而非实测记录。

Node 版本：`package.json` 的 `engines` 要求 **`node >= 22`**（脚本只用了 `node:` 内置模块，无第三方依赖）。

DSH 版本：本包**没有** `engines.dsh`，四个 peer 依赖都写成 `"*"` 且全部 optional：

```json
"peerDependencies": {
  "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "*",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction": "*",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter": "*",
  "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "*"
}
```

所以 `dsh plugin add` 不会因为版本号拒绝安装；真正的门槛是 API 是否存在：插件需要宿主提供 `agent/pre-step` 事件、`ctx.tokenMeter.measure()`、`ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded()`。本仓库在 **dsh 0.2.1-rc.2** 上实测（`dsh --version`）。harness 若缺少 `compaction` 或 `tokenMeter` 服务，插件会挂载不上而不是报错——见[排错](#排错)。

## 安装

1. 确认工具链（两个平台一样）：

   ```bash
   node --version    # 需要 v22 或更高
   dsh --version
   ```

2. 装进你要用的 profile（`web` 是最常见的；profile 不存在时 `dsh plugin` 会初始化它）：

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-resume-budget
   ```

   这条命令把包装进 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`，并把它加进该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。首次安装需要能访问 GitHub（pnpm 拉取 `github:` 依赖）。

3. **重启宿主进程**（完全退出再启动）。插件是在宿主启动时被 import 的，装完不会热加载：

   ```bash
   dsh web
   ```

4. 按下一节验证，或直接恢复一个历史很长的会话看效果。

**安装命令唯一的系统差异是 `DSH_HOME` 的写法**，`dsh plugin add` 本身完全一样：

| 平台 | 默认 `DSH_HOME` | profile 目录 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows（PowerShell） | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`（`$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh`） | `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web` |
| macOS（zsh） | `~/.dsh` | `~/.dsh/profiles/web` |
| Linux | `~/.dsh`（或 `$XDG` 习惯下的自定义值） | `~/.dsh/profiles/web` |

设置了 `DSH_HOME` 的话以它为准，`check.mjs` 也读同一个变量。

## 验证

在**仓库 checkout 里**运行（用仓库里的这一份；脚本本身不依赖 `lib/`）：

```bash
node scripts/check.mjs
```

装好插件后不想 clone 的话，profile 里安装的副本也有同一份脚本：

```powershell
# PowerShell
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-resume-budget\scripts\check.mjs"
```

```zsh
# zsh
node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-resume-budget/scripts/check.mjs
```

它做两件事，和 `scripts/check.sh` 完全一致：

1. 在 `dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config` 的组合树里找 `id: resume-budget`；
2. 找 `thresholdTokens: <期望值>`。

默认 profile 是 `web`，默认期望阈值是 `100000`（即 bundle 自带的默认值）。安装正常时应看到：

```text
$ node scripts/check.mjs
ok:   resume-budget is in the composed tree
ok:   thresholdTokens is 100000
```

如果你在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里改过阈值，把期望值作为第二个参数传进去，否则第二条会变成 `WARN`：

```bash
node scripts/check.mjs web 150000
# ok:   resume-budget is in the composed tree
# ok:   thresholdTokens is 150000
```

两个参数的含义：

| 参数 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 第 1 个：profile | `web` | 要检查哪个 profile 的组合树，必须与 `dsh plugin --profile` 用的名字一致。 |
| 第 2 个：expected-threshold | `100000` | **只用于比对，不会修改任何配置**。它回答“组合树里的阈值是不是我以为的那个数”。 |

输出约定：`ok:` 表示通过；`FAIL:` 写到 stderr 且**退出码 1**（行缺失、profile 不存在、`dsh` 起不来）；`WARN:` 写到 stderr 但**退出码仍是 0**（只是阈值对不上，组合树里可能仍然是可用配置）。常见错误：

```text
FAIL: no such profile: C:\Users\you\.dsh\profiles\nope
WARN: thresholdTokens 100000 not found in the composed tree
```

`DSH_HOME` 不在默认位置时：

```powershell
# PowerShell
$env:DSH_HOME = 'D:\dsh-home'; node scripts/check.mjs web 150000
```

```zsh
# zsh
DSH_HOME=~/dsh-home node scripts/check.mjs web 150000
```

macOS / Linux 也可以用原来的 `bash scripts/check.sh web 150000`，两者输出一致。

## 配置

只有一个配置键，定义在 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config`（schemastery）：

| 键 | 类型 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thresholdTokens` | number，整数，最小 0 | `100000`（`DEFAULT_RESUME_INPUT_TOKENS`） | 恢复会话第一个请求的**预计输入**达到这个数就先压缩。`0` 表示整个策略关闭。 |

几处边界行为：`0` 关闭检查；预计输入小于阈值不压缩，**等于阈值会触发**（`>=`）。`lib/decision.js` 的 `normaliseThreshold()` 对 `undefined`、`null`、负数、`NaN`、`Infinity` 一律回退到默认 100000 而不是 0；但走 YAML 配置时，`Config` 的 `min(0)` 和 `step(1)` 会让负数、小数在校验阶段就被拒绝。

改阈值要改 profile 的用户层 patch，不是改这个仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml`（那是 bundle 的默认值，重装会被覆盖）。在你的 profile patch 里加一段按 `id` 覆盖的配置：

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: resume-budget
  config:
    thresholdTokens: 150000
```

- `id` 必须正好是 `resume-budget`（`lib/index.js` 里 `export const name = "resume-budget"`）。写错了宿主启动时只会打印 `patch: entry "..." not found` 然后继续，组合树里仍是 100000——这是最容易“以为改了其实没改”的地方。
- 改完保存：profile 的 `patchReload` 为 `live` 时宿主会热加载 patch；否则重启宿主。
- 想临时关掉整条策略，把值设成 `0`。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-resume-budget
```

它会移除依赖、`dsh.profile.bundles` 里的对应项和该 profile `node_modules` 里的副本。然后**重启宿主**，插件不再被 import。

不会自动消失的东西：

- **你自己在 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 里加的 `- id: resume-budget` 覆盖块**（如果你加过）。pnpm 不管这个文件；留着它每次启动都会打印 `patch: entry "resume-budget" not found` 的警告，手动删掉即可。
- 已经写进会话的压缩检查点。压缩是把历史遮罩/摘要后落盘的，卸载插件不会把旧历史恢复回来。
- profile 目录里的 `*.bak-*` 备份和 pnpm 缓存，按需自行清理。

## 排错

| 症状 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，恢复会话却没有任何变化 | 插件只在宿主**启动**时被 import；`add` 只改了 profile 的依赖和组合树，对已经跑着的进程无效 | 完全退出宿主再启动（Web 界面刷新页面不算）。启动后用 `node scripts/check.mjs` 确认行确实在组合树里。 |
| 改了 `lib/*.js`，行为没变 | 已加载的 ESM 模块不会重新求值（模块缓存），`patchReload` 只重载配置 patch，不改代码 | 重启宿主。注意安装方式：`dsh plugin add /abs/path` 是 `link:`，重启就能吃到本地改动；`github:` 安装的是 pnpm 复制到 profile 里的副本，改本仓库不会影响它，需要重新 `add`/更新依赖。 |
| `dsh plugin add` 卡住或失败（`ETIMEDOUT`、`ECONNRESET`、`ERR_PNPM_FETCH_*`、证书错误） | `github:` 规格是交给 pnpm 的，pnpm 需要直连 github.com / codeload 拉 tarball | 给 pnpm/环境配代理（`HTTPS_PROXY`、`HTTP_PROXY` 或 `.npmrc` 的 `proxy`/`https-proxy`）后重试。内网机器可先 `git clone`，再 `dsh plugin --profile web add <本地绝对路径>` 做本地 link 安装；随后跑 `node scripts/dev-link.mjs` 让它能解析 harness 的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包。 |
| 阈值像是不触发（恢复大会话也没压缩） | 检查只针对**本进程内恢复或 fork 来的会话**，且每个会话只判一次；新建会话、子代理、历史很短的会话永远不会触发。`measure()` 是启发式估算，可能比你估的低。插件不弹 UI 提示，所以“没看到反应”不等于“没生效” | 先 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 或 `node scripts/check.mjs web <你的阈值>` 确认组合树里的值（patch 的 id 写错会静默保留 100000）。再临时把 `thresholdTokens` 设成 `1` 并重启，恢复一个旧会话：成功压缩后会话里会多出压缩后端写回的检查点（`dsh-compaction-basic` 的 `<compacted-summary>` 块）；若历史太短、后端返回 `null`，则什么也不会发生，这是设计。看到检查点就说明“闸门开了”，看完把阈值改回去。也可以只验证决策分支：`node -e "import('./lib/decision.js').then(({shouldCompactOnResume}) => console.log(shouldCompactOnResume({pending:true,estimatedInputTokens:150000},{thresholdTokens:100000})))"`。 |
| 与 harness 版本不匹配：`dsh` 启动报错，或 `dsh plugin add` 打印 `Plugin … is incompatible with dsh …` | 本包 peers 是 `*`，但宿主 API 可能缺失/改签名（`agent/pre-step`、`ctx.tokenMeter.measure`、`ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded`）。插件 `inject: ["compaction", "tokenMeter"]`，服务缺一个就挂载不上，通常是静默不生效 | `dsh --version` 对照；升级到 0.2.x（实测 0.2.1-rc.2，含上述两个服务和 `context-overflow` 触发分支）。harness 的兼容性检查不通过时，按提示升级插件；确要试跑可用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 授予精确版本豁免。 |
| `node scripts/check.mjs` 报 `FAIL: no such profile: …` | `DSH_HOME` 或 profile 名不对 | Windows 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，macOS/Linux 是 `~/.dsh`；profile 名必须与安装时用的一致。必要时显式设 `DSH_HOME`。 |
| `WARN: thresholdTokens … not found` 但退出码是 0 | 你在 patch 里改了阈值，却没把新值作为第二个参数传给 `check.mjs`；或 patch 的 `id` 拼错导致覆盖没生效 | `node scripts/check.mjs web <你的值>`；同时看宿主启动日志里有没有 `patch: entry "…" not found`。 |
| Windows 下 `bash scripts/check.sh` 报 `set: pipefail: invalid option name` | Git（`core.autocrlf=true`）把 `.sh` 检出成 CRLF，bash 不认这种行尾 | 用 `node scripts/check.mjs`；或 `git config core.autocrlf false` 后重新检出仓库。 |
| 在自定义 profile（没挂压缩后端或 token meter）里完全不生效 | 插件的 `inject: ["compaction", "tokenMeter"]` 永远等不到服务，宿主不会报错 | 换到带 `dsh-compaction-basic` 的 profile
